description: Test whether the five basic-patch residues are enriched for Lys/Arg conservation relative to all other exposed core positions
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
tsv=S.get('https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream?query=xref:panther-PTHR13651'
          '&fields=accession,organism_name,sequence&format=tsv',timeout=180).text
L=[l.split('\t') for l in tsv.strip().split('\n')]; hdr=L[0]
recs=[dict(zip(hdr,r)) for r in L[1:]]
MOUSE=[r['Sequence'] for r in recs if r['Entry']=='Q80ZQ9'][0]
pool={}
for r in recs:
    s=r['Sequence']
    if r['Entry']=='Q80ZQ9' or not (150<len(s)<400): continue
    pool.setdefault(s,r['Organism'])
items=sorted(pool.items()); rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
sel=[items[i] for i in rng.choice(len(items),size=400,replace=False)]

bl="""A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V
4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
-1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
-2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
-2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
-1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
-1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
-2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
-1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
-1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
-1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
-1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
-2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
-1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
-3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
-2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -2 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
rr=bl.split('\n'); AA=rr[0].split(); SUB=np.full((128,128),-4.0)
for a,row in zip(AA,rr[1:]):
    for b,v in zip(AA,row.split()): SUB[ord(a),ord(b)]=float(v)
mo=np.frombuffer(MOUSE.encode(),dtype=np.uint8); n=len(MOUSE); G=-8.0; NEG=-1e9
def nw_diag(b):
    bo=np.frombuffer(b.encode(),dtype=np.uint8); m=len(b); Sm=SUB[np.ix_(mo,bo)]
    H=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); P=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    H[0,:]=G*np.arange(m+1); H[:,0]=G*np.arange(n+1); P[0,1:]=2; P[1:,0]=1
    for d in range(2,n+m+1):
        i=np.arange(max(1,d-m),min(n,d-1)+1)
        if not len(i): continue
        j=d-i
        cand=np.stack([H[i-1,j-1]+Sm[i-1,j-1],H[i-1,j]+G,H[i,j-1]+G])
        k=np.argmax(cand,0); H[i,j]=cand[k,np.arange(len(i))]; P[i,j]=k
    i,j=n,m; col=np.full(n,'-',dtype='<U1')
    while i>0 and j>0:
        k=P[i,j]
        if k==0: col[i-1]=b[j-1]; i-=1; j-=1
        elif k==1: i-=1
        else: j-=1
    return col
MAT=np.array([nw_diag(s) for s,_ in sel])            # 400 x 193 mouse-anchored columns
pctKR=100*np.isin(MAT,['K','R']).mean(0)
pctID=100*(MAT==np.array(list(MOUSE))[None,:]).mean(0)

# surface exposure on the AF model core
RES3={'ALA','ARG','ASN','ASP','CYS','GLN','GLU','GLY','HIS','ILE','LEU','LYS','MET','PHE','PRO','SER','THR','TRP','TYR','VAL'}
VDW={'C':1.70,'N':1.55,'O':1.52,'S':1.80}
MAXA={'ALA':129,'ARG':274,'ASN':195,'ASP':193,'CYS':167,'GLN':225,'GLU':223,'GLY':104,'HIS':224,'ILE':197,'LEU':201,'LYS':236,'MET':224,'PHE':240,'PRO':159,'SER':155,'THR':172,'TRP':285,'TYR':263,'VAL':174}
meta=S.get('https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q80ZQ9',timeout=90).json()[0]
af=S.get(meta['pdbUrl'],timeout=90).text; assert len(af)>50000
res={}
for Ln in af.splitlines():
    if not Ln.startswith('ATOM') or Ln[17:20].strip() not in RES3: continue
    el=(Ln[76:78].strip() or Ln[12:16].strip()[0]).upper()
    if el not in VDW: continue
    k=(int(Ln[22:26]),Ln[17:20].strip()); res.setdefault(k,[[],[],[]])
    res[k][0].append((float(Ln[30:38]),float(Ln[38:46]),float(Ln[46:54])))
    res[k][1].append(el); res[k][2].append(float(Ln[60:66]))
rs=[(num,rn,np.array(x),e,float(np.mean(b))) for (num,rn),(x,e,b) in sorted(res.items())]
nsp=92; kk=np.arange(nsp)+0.5; phi=np.arccos(1-2*kk/nsp); th=np.pi*(1+5**0.5)*kk
SP=np.stack([np.cos(th)*np.sin(phi),np.sin(th)*np.sin(phi),np.cos(phi)],1)
C=np.vstack([r[2] for r in rs]); R=np.array([VDW[e] for r in rs for e in r[3]])+1.4
own=np.concatenate([[i]*len(r[3]) for i,r in enumerate(rs)]); tree=cKDTree(C); rmax=R.max()
A=np.zeros(len(rs))
for i in range(len(C)):
    nb=np.array(tree.query_ball_point(C[i],R[i]+rmax)); nb=nb[nb!=i]
    pts=C[i]+R[i]*SP
    acc=(np.linalg.norm(pts[:,None,:]-C[nb][None,:,:],axis=2)>=R[nb][None,:]).all(1) if len(nb) else np.ones(nsp,bool)
    A[own[i]]+=4*np.pi*R[i]**2*acc.sum()/nsp
rel=np.array([A[i]/MAXA[r[1]] for i,r in enumerate(rs)]); plddt=np.array([r[4] for r in rs])
pos=np.array([r[0] for r in rs])
core_exposed=(plddt>=70)&(rel>0.25)
ce=pos[core_exposed]-1                               # 0-based mouse indices
PATCH=[96,99,128,130,161]; pidx=np.array(PATCH)-1
bg=np.setdiff1d(ce,pidx)
u,pu=stats.mannwhitneyu(pctKR[pidx],pctKR[bg],alternative='greater')
rank=[int((pctKR[ce]>pctKR[p-1]).sum())+1 for p in PATCH]
print(f"exposed core positions (pLDDT>=70, relSASA>0.25): {len(ce)}")
print(f"patch %K/R  : {np.round(pctKR[pidx],1)}  median {np.median(pctKR[pidx]):.1f}")
print(f"background  : median {np.median(pctKR[bg]):.1f}  IQR {np.percentile(pctKR[bg],25):.1f}-{np.percentile(pctKR[bg],75):.1f}")
print(f"Mann-Whitney U={u:.0f}, one-sided p={pu:.2g}; rank of each patch residue among {len(ce)} exposed: {rank}")
# rank-biserial effect size
rb=2*u/(len(pidx)*len(bg))-1
print(f"rank-biserial r = {rb:.3f}")
top=np.argsort(-pctKR[ce])[:12]
print("\ntop 12 exposed core positions by %K/R across 400 orthologs:")
for t in top:
    p=ce[t]+1
    print(f"  {MOUSE[p-1]}{p}: K/R {pctKR[p-1]:.1f}%  identical {pctID[p-1]:.1f}%  relSASA {rel[list(pos).index(p)]:.2f}"
          + ("   <- in largest basic patch" if p in PATCH else ""))
pd.DataFrame({'pos':np.arange(1,n+1),'mouse_aa':list(MOUSE),'pct_KR':pctKR.round(1),
              'pct_identical':pctID.round(1)}).to_csv(
   '/agent/jobs/7fa3ef47-758c-4d83-8be4-ef31af2ced2a/provenance/per_position_conservation.csv',index=False)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(12,6.4),sharex=True)
ax[0].bar(np.arange(1,n+1),pctKR,color=['#c44e52' if (i+1) in PATCH else
          ('#4878a8' if (i) in ce else '#cccccc') for i in range(n)],width=1.0)
ax[0].set_ylabel('% orthologs K or R'); ax[0].set_title('Lys/Arg conservation per mouse Abitram position (400 orthologs)')
for p in PATCH: ax[0].annotate(f"{MOUSE[p-1]}{p}",(p,pctKR[p-1]),textcoords='offset points',xytext=(0,3),ha='center',fontsize=7.5)
ax[1].plot(pos,plddt,color='#555555',lw=1.0,label='pLDDT')
ax[1].axhline(70,ls=':',color='k',lw=0.7); ax[1].set_ylabel('pLDDT'); ax[1].set_xlabel('mouse Abitram residue')
for p in PATCH: ax[1].axvline(p,color='#c44e52',lw=0.8,alpha=0.6)
ax[1].legend(fontsize=8)
fig.suptitle('Basic patch K96/R99/R128/R130/K161 sits in the ordered GcvH-fold core and is charge-conserved',fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
